subject: Phased Close Recovery & MAP Reconciliation
messages:
From: Elaine Todd <elaine.todd@nimbus.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurements@nimbus.ai>
Date: 2027-09-28T08:15:00-04:00
Subject: Concern: MAP milestones slipping — evaluation blockers

Hi Grace / team,

Quick note from our side — the MAP we agreed to during the trial has started to slip. Security sign-off (ISO evidence + network MAC/IP list) is still outstanding and is blocking our infra team from running the extended POC. The evaluation committee also wants to see the 2 extended prompts run end-to-end before the 30th.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide a compact evidence package by EOD tomorrow and whether we can get a short-term staging environment to finish the last runs? If not, we need to talk about resetting the close target.

Thanks,
Elaine
Elaine Todd
Director, Platform Integrations
NimbusAnalytics
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Todd <elaine.todd@nimbus.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-28T10:02:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Concern: MAP milestones slipping — evaluation blockers

Elaine — thanks for the heads up. We're on it. Quick summary of options and a proposed phased MAP to recover the timeline: 

- Phase A (Critical path, target: 2027-09-30):
  * Deliver security evidence bundle (SOC excerpt, KMS summary, network allowlist template)
  * Provide short-lived staging (single-region, limited tokens) so your infra team can run the final prompts

- Phase B (Stability and scale, target: 2027-10-07):
  * Full perf runs across expected seq lengths
  * Canary rollout plan and fallback to lighter quantized variant

Trade-offs: Phase A reduces the close risk by enabling evaluation but does not include long-run throughput tuning. If you need throughput data before committing, we'll need dedicated infra for a few days (see Markus's cost note below).

I've attached a quick proposed_phased_map.xlsx and a risk_register_q4.csv with the immediate mitigations and owners. Please confirm whether Phase A acceptance criteria (security bundle + two final prompt runs) are sufficient for you to keep the 10/12 target, or whether you prefer a formal reset.

Proposed next step: 30-min alignment call this afternoon (2pm ET). Are you available?

— Grace
Grace O'Connor | Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: +1 (415) 555-0182 | grace_oconnor@redwood.com
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Elaine Todd <elaine.todd@nimbus.ai>
Date: 2027-09-28T11:30:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Concern: MAP milestones slipping — evaluation blockers

FWIW — if Nimbus needs deterministic exit criteria before 10/12, we can stand up a dedicated 2-GPU pool for 48 hours to run the remaining test matrix and capture throughput/latency. Rough runbook: upload model snapshot -> run canonical prompts -> produce token-level latency CSVs. Estimated service charge: $4,300 (one-time).

I'm attaching budget_estimate_dedicated.pdf. I recommend we surface this as an approved OTO (one-time option) and route to procurement. If they approve, we can avoid rebaselining.

— Markus
Markus Klein | Head of Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Elaine Todd <elaine.todd@nimbus.ai>
Date: 2027-09-28T14:45:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Concern: MAP milestones slipping — evaluation blockers

Agree with Markus — and one operational ask: we should propose a staged acceptance that lets Nimbus sign off on Phase A artifacts and then sign a limited amendment for a short Dedicated window if they want throughput numbers. That keeps legal/procurement happy and avoids a full schedule reset.

Also: add a canary validation step to the Phase B plan (validate responses on 50 real prompts before wide runs). I'll draft the amendment language and loop in procurement once Elaine confirms.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor | Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Todd <elaine.todd@nimbus.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurements@nimbus.ai>
Date: 2027-09-29T09:05:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Concern: MAP milestones slipping — evaluation blockers

Elaine — per our internal alignment, here's the official rebaseline proposal that keeps momentum and gives Nimbus the artifacts you need: 

1) Immediate deliverables (by 2027-09-30 EOD):
   - Security evidence bundle (SOC excerpts, KMS config summary, network allowlist template) — owner: Redwood Security (via Markus)
   - Short-lived staging environment (single-region, 48-hour window) to run two final prompts — owner: Solutions Eng (Markus)

2) Contingent Dedicated window (optional, if you require throughput):
   - 48-hour Dedicated run to capture latency/throughput — cost estimate attached; procurement sign-off required

3) Acceptance criteria to preserve original close window (no formal reset):
   - Security bundle received and accepted
   - Two final prompt runs completed in staging with zero critical failures

If those are acceptable, we can keep the close target at 2027-10-12. If not, we propose a soft reset to 2027-10-19 to allow a broader perf sweep.

I've attached the phased MAP and risk register again and included a link to the HubSpot deal for reference. Can we lock a 2pm ET call today to confirm?

Thanks — I'll wait for quick confirmation so Neha and I can kick procurement if needed.

— Grace
Grace O'Connor | Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Elaine Todd <elaine.todd@nimbus.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurements@nimbus.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-29T10:10:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Concern: MAP milestones slipping — evaluation blockers

Grace — thanks for the clear options and the phased plan. Phase A acceptance criteria look fine. We confirm the security artefacts are the gating items; procurement will review the Dedicated estimate this morning.

2pm ET works for a call — Elaine and I will be on.

Best,
Elaine
